The
Claflin Company
(Claflin ALM) is a full-line wholesale distributor of medical, surgical, and pharmaceutical products that also provides advanced logistics and supply chain management for healthcare providers. It was
founded in
1817
and is headquartered in
Warwick, Rhode Island
. While they distribute a wide array of basic medical supplies, diagnostic equipment, and surgical products
, they do not specialize in or prominently feature high-tech consumer or wearable medical devices in their core catalog.
Crunchbase
What the Company Does
Operates as a medical-surgical wholesale distributor and third-party logistics (3PL) provider.
Sources supplies from over 500 vendors to service hospitals, clinics, and healthcare networks.
Specializes in custom supply chain strategies like Just-In-Time (JIT) delivery inventory systems.
